lojaDashboard.subtitle: Track quotes and orders from repair shops
comoFuncionaItens: Repair shops post quotes requesting parts they need
You respond with a price and delivery time
The shop picks the best offer and confirms the order
Arrange delivery and payment directly with the shop

lojaAprender.subtitulo: One step at a time. Choose Guided mode for detailed instructions, or Self-paced if you'd rather try it yourself.

como-funciona.resumo: Repair shops post part requests ("quotes"). You respond with a price and delivery time. The shop picks the best offer and confirms the order. Delivery and payment are arranged directly with the shop — BipFix doesn't process that. Only when you mark the order as delivered does BipFix charge a small commission.
passosGuiados: Open Dashboard in the menu and read the "How it works" card.
Notice the 3 numbers: open quotes to respond to, confirmed orders, and active parts in your catalog.
como-funciona.desafio: Understand the full flow before you start: quote → response → confirmed order → delivery → commission.

perfil.resumo: Complete your store's details — correct address, city, state, and postal code matter, even though they don't filter the quotes you see today (every open quote in Brazil currently shows up for you, with no distance filter yet).
passosGuiados: Check/edit your trade name, tax ID, address, city, and state.
perfil.desafio: Make sure your store's registration is complete and accurate (no "To be defined" left in the address).

catalogo.resumo: Register the parts you have in stock: name, make/model/year compatibility, price, and quantity. It works as your internal stock tracker inside BipFix.
passosGuiados: Fill in the name and price (required) — make, model, year, and description are optional.
catalogo.desafio: Register at least one part in your catalog.

cotacoes.resumo: This is where you compete for sales: a list of part requests posted by repair shops, waiting for a response. A good price and delivery time boost your chances of being picked. Only the shop sees every response — other stores can't see your price.
passosGuiados: Find an open quote for a part you have.
Fill in the price, delivery time in days, and a note if you'd like.
cotacoes.desafio: Respond to at least one shop quote with a real price and delivery time.
cotacoes.dica: Responding fast (under 2 hours) lowers your commission rate later on.

pedidos.resumo: When a shop picks your response, the order shows up here. Arrange delivery and payment directly with the shop (outside the platform), and once you've actually delivered, mark it as delivered.
passosGuiados: Arrange delivery/payment with the shop (use the "Chat" link if you need to).
Once you've actually delivered, click "Mark as delivered".
pedidos.desafio: Mark a confirmed order as delivered.

comissao.resumo: The rate starts at 3% and drops as you respond quickly and deliver a good volume of orders — 1.5% minimum in practice. It's only charged once the order is marked as delivered, never before.
passosGuiados: See your current rate, what's pending, and what's already been paid.
comissao.desafio: Check your current rate and what you can do to lower it.
